department: PhD in Photonics (with UPC Doctoral School)

deadline.value: Apply only through calls/openings on ICFOjobs, each with its own deadline. No PhD call was open on 2026-10-21; candidates may contact group leaders meanwhile.
deadline.quote: Please consult openings for further information on available projects and positions, as well as for elegibility, conditions, required application material and deadlines.

also.quote: All candidates must apply to a call through the ICFOJobs Website. | No calls available for Phd Students

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: Admission needs a pass from the admissions committee after interview AND an offer from at least one host research group with confirmed fellowship funding
supervisor.quote: To be admitted into the program, candidates must pass the evaluation by the admissions committee following the interview in step 4a, and have an offer of acceptance into one or more host research groups with confirmed funding for the corresponding fellowship.

funding.value: All admitted students are fully funded through (competitive) fellowships for the whole PhD; fellowships cover a 6-month trainee period plus a 4-year PhD period
funding.quote: All students admitted into the program are fully funded through competitive fellowships.

also.quote: Regardless of the specific funding mechanism, ICFO PhD Fellows will be fully funded throughout the entire PhD Program.

entry_route.value: Master-equivalent degree required by the PhD start date; non-EHEA degrees must equal an official Spanish master's and give access to doctoral studies in the issuing country
entry_route.quote: An internationally recognized Master-equivalent degree. The degree must be completed by the start of your prospective PhD at ICFO, at the latest | Degrees issued outside EHEA must offer a level of training equivalent to an official Spanish master’s degree and qualify the holder for admission to doctoral studies in the country where it was issued.

notes: Photonics PhD awarded with UPC. Selection: eligibility and admissibility checks, committee evaluation, on-site interviews; under 10% of applicants admitted. Applicants who already hold a PhD are not eligible. Self-funded or external fellowships (e.g. LaCaixa INPhINIT) are also possible.
name: ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences
